deviations.what: c14 C5 *Donation receipt · no tax language* and c16 C5 *Donation receipt · trust only*: not built — the whole screen ('Receipt' header with 'No. 0431', the receipt card with the trust's Gurmukhi and English names, 'Rukka Folio · Trust register · Regd. 1979', receipt number and date, 'RECEIVED WITH THANKS FROM' with the donor's name in Gurmukhi and English, the amount '₹21,000' with words in Punjabi and English, 'TOWARDS' / 'RECEIVED IN', 'An acknowledgement of your sewa. Not a tax document.' with the signatory line, a 'Language on the receipt' toggle (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ + EN · हिंदी) and a navy 'Share' button) has no widget in the app. Its parent, S4.1 entry detail, offers no receipt door (capture S4.1__default), so no production path reaches it
deviations.reason: [screen] deferred, not a defect — donation receipts move to the next phase; S4.2 was never built and no F1 test exists. screen_files names the parent door so this record goes stale when S4.1 changes. The two frames differ only in the signatory ('President' vs 'Secretary')
